notes: Full fine-tuning (not LP) per US-006. TransNeXt §A.3 specifies AdamW + cosine, weight decay 5e-2, label smoothing 0.0 for LP. For full FT we keep WD anchor 5e-2 and let the search relax LS in [0, 0.1]. Backbone LR is much smaller than head LR because the backbone is pretrained.

head_lr.citation: papers/TransNeXt.pdf §A.3 — head LR 1e-3 (LP), inherited as FT head anchor

backbone_lr.citation: papers/TransNeXt.pdf §A.3 — full FT typically uses backbone LR 1e-5 to 1e-4 for ImageNet-pretrained ViTs
backbone_lr.note: Anchor 5e-5 (project default for full FT). LP anchor was 0 (frozen) — full FT requires non-zero backbone LR. ±1 decade range.

weight_decay.note: Anchor 5e-2 (CLAUDE.md TransNeXt row). ViTs are sensitive to WD; ±1 decade.

label_smoothing.citation: papers/TransNeXt.pdf §A.3 — label smoothing 0.0 for linear probe; FT can tolerate small LS
label_smoothing.note: Anchor 0.0 (CLAUDE.md TransNeXt LP row); FT search allows up to 0.1.

warmup_epochs.citation: papers/TransNeXt.pdf §A.3 — cosine schedule with linear warmup standard for ViTs
warmup_epochs.note: Float; tune_all.py rounds to int. Anchor 5 (typical ViT warmup); wider than CNNs because ViTs benefit more from warmup during full FT.
